source_bytes.basis: The pinned New York PBF plus two Copernicus GLO-30 tiles total 559861558 bytes; 768 MiB retains bounded transport headroom.

canonical_bytes.basis: The footprint retains the accepted 210-cell Kazan physical extent while D0 proves substantially higher feature density; 4 GiB is a bounded first-showcase ceiling.

full_compile_seconds.basis: Thirty minutes bounds the first high-density 210-cell compile without treating a slow run as acceptable indefinitely.

features.basis: Exact D0 source census is below this ceiling across Buildings, roads, Water, vegetation, and land-cover inputs.

cells.basis: The Kazan-equivalent inclusive selection x=-6..8 and y=-6..7 contains exactly 210 cells.

generated_packages.basis: Allows the map, 210 terrain cells, spatial layer packages, and bounded World Partition external packages.

unreal_import_seconds.basis: The same bounded unattended realization ceiling used by the accepted territory pipeline.

cook_seconds.basis: One hour bounds the first Shipping cook and must be measured against the real product route.

installed_bytes.basis: The showcase shares runtime code/resources and must remain inside the accepted 8 GiB first-territory envelope.

generated_actor_count.basis: Cell-local massing preserves one actor per occupied layer cell rather than one actor per source Building or part.

p95_frame_time_ms.basis: Release 2.0 target is 60 FPS at High 1440p on the physical RTX 4070 reference adapter.

peak_memory_bytes.basis: Packaged process memory remains capped at 12 GiB on the reference route.

peak_gpu_memory_bytes.basis: Dedicated GPU memory remains capped at 10 GiB on the 12 GiB RTX 4070.

streaming_cell_load_seconds.basis: Each requested World Partition cell must become usable within two seconds.

streaming_hitch_ms.basis: Streaming must not create a measured hitch longer than 50 ms.

territory_traversal_seconds.basis: The automated PreviewFlight route must exercise center, edge, unload, and reload inside fifteen minutes.
